blocks.text: I can describe changes in spring.
Tap each word to see what it means.

items.def: A year can be split into four seasons. Each season lasts about three months.
Spring is the season that comes after winter and before summer.
To observe is to look very closely and use other senses too.
To say or write what someone or something is like.
If something changes it does not stay the same.

blocks.text: There are twelve months in one year.
A year can be split into four seasons.
Each season lasts about three months.
The four seasons are winter, spring, summer and autumn.

items.title: autumn
items.sub: Leaves turn orange, red and yellow.

blocks.q: Is it a season or a month?

blocks.text: Spring comes after winter.
Spring comes before summer.
Spring is in {March}, {April} and {May}.
Alex walks in the park in March.
Some trees look different in spring.
They have **buds** on them.
Buds have new leaves or flowers inside. They are ready to grow.
Look for buds and blossom on trees near you.
Alex listens carefully.
He hears a bird singing in a tree.
This is **birdsong**.
Many birds return to the United Kingdom from warmer places as spring begins.
Flowers start to grow in the ground and in pots.
These flowers appear each spring.

blocks.label: Watch out!
blocks.text: Look at flowers. Do not pick them all. Then other people can enjoy them too.

items.title: blossom
items.sub: Little pink flowers on a tree.

items.title: catkins
items.sub: Lots of little flowers on a tree.

items.title: frogspawn
items.sub: In a pond. Tadpoles come soon.

items.title: a nibbled leaf
items.sub: A caterpillar has been eating it.

items.q: Which is a sign of spring?

blocks.text: Alex and his friends look closely at things around them.
They use their **observation skills**.
When we observe, we look very closely and use other senses too.
We can look. We can touch. We can listen for signs of spring too.
When we observe carefully, we can describe what we notice.

blocks.label: Describe the buds
blocks.text: The buds look brown and green. The buds are a pointy round shape.
What could you say about a flower you see?

blocks.q: You hear a bird singing in a tree. What do you use to observe it?
blocks.why: We can listen for signs of spring as well as see them.

items: A year can be divided into four seasons.
Spring is in March, April and May.
The first signs of spring are birdsong, buds on trees and early flowers.
We can describe changes in spring using observation skills.

worksheet.instructions: Answer each question with one word, one number or a short answer.

questions.prompt: How many months are there in one year?

questions.prompt: Each season lasts for around how many months?
questions.explanation: Each season lasts for around three months.

questions.prompt: Which season comes after winter and before summer?
questions.explanation: Spring is the season that comes after winter and before summer.
